title: Airport Explorer Demo
description: Loads a local GeoJSON of Japan airport polygons; dropdown selection flies to and highlights the chosen airport, with a polygon visibility toggle.

title: Airport Layer Filter Demo
description: Loads an airport analysis GeoJSON as colored circles, filterable by 'important_layer' via dropdown, with a togglable Mapbox Streets aeroway fill layer.

title: Japan Airports OSM Demo
description: Loads a local OSM-derived Japan airport GeoJSON, showing civilian vs military polygons/labels; dropdown selection flies to and highlights an airport.

title: AMAP
description: Uses the AMap (Gaode) JS SDK, not Mapbox GL JS, showing a 3D Beijing map with a marker/popup, a polyline, a toolbar control, and a live traffic layer.

title: Building Heatmap
description: Uses mapbox-gl-compare for a side-by-side view; the 'before' map fills a local buildings GeoJSON colored by a numeric property, filtered by height and name.

title: SearchBox POI検索
description: Search Box API demo with three modes: nested category browser, autocomplete suggest search, and forward text search, each with optional category filters.

title: Cell Coverage Map
description: Loads a custom mbxsolutions Mapbox style with a coverage legend and FPS meter; its Geocoding API and Tilequery API search/click handlers are commented out and never run.

title: Cluster (GeoJSON)
description: Loads a local ports GeoJSON, clusters it via GL JS 'cluster: true', shows cluster counts and port icons, click-to-zoom clusters, and a property-table popup.

title: Cluster (MTS)
description: Renders a hosted Mapbox vector tileset of ports with pre-aggregated 'count' clusters and icons; clicking a port only logs its properties, no popup shown.

title: Deliveries
description: Lets user pick a travel profile/time, then calls the Isochrone API per delivery center to build catchment polygons and color-assign delivery points to them.

title: TV POI Details Search
description: Nested category browser searching the Search Box category endpoint, then also calling the separate Mapbox Details API to fetch enriched POI attributes.

title: DHL Capabilities Demo - Mapbox GL JS
description: Multi-scenario DHL shipment demo: Directions API driving-traffic routes with ETA, and Map Matching API snapping of GPS tracks to roads, with raw/road toggles.

title: Directions Comparison - Mapbox vs Google
description: Compares Mapbox Directions API and Google Routes API v2 side by side on click-set origin/destination, with avoid toggles, congestion-colored routes, and batch CSV export against preset delivery/ferry route datasets.

title: Dynamic Style — Label Language
description: Loads the stock Mapbox Streets style and, on a toggle, rewrites every label layer's text-field expression in place to switch between English and Japanese names.

title: Submit Feedback - Mapbox Feedback API
description: Form to submit map-data feedback: pick a location by map click, coordinates, or geolocation, reverse-geocodes it via Geocoding v5, and POSTs to the Mapbox user-feedback v1 API.

title: Mapbox Feedback API - Data Table View
description: Grid.js-powered dashboard that pages, filters, and exports (CSV/JSON) feedback items from the Mapbox user-feedback v1 API, with a map drawer showing each item's location.

title: Fixed Optimization
description: Vehicle-routing tool: builds shipments/vehicles, solves them via the Optimization API v2, draws each route leg with the Directions API, and uses Search Box, Geocoding, and Tilequery for address input and stop placement.

title: Flight Map
description: Animates a 3D airplane model along a fixed SF-to-London flight path with a time scrubber, satellite/standard style toggle, and an overview/chase-camera orbit mode.

title: Fuzzy Geocoding
description: Geocodes a user-entered address via Geocoding API v6 forward, retrying with regex-based address simplification if the first attempt returns no results.

title: India Boundaries Coverage
description: For each listed place, either fills a live Mapbox Boundaries vector tileset polygon (looked up via a local name index) or falls back to a Search Box API suggest+retrieve point lookup.

title: Indoor Airports - Brazil
description: Tours 11 Brazilian airports with Mapbox's native indoor map tiles (showIndoor + IndoorControl), a day/night light-preset picker, and an auto-playing cinematic camera tour.

title: Indoor Airport Navigation
description: Shows Mapbox indoor floor data via a custom indoor-enabled style at six airports, with GeolocateControl tracking the user's real GPS position and click-to-inspect indoor feature info.

title: Indoor Airports - Search
description: Searchable list of dozens of airports (hardcoded coordinates, filtered locally) that flies the map to Mapbox's native indoor map tiles for the selected airport.

title: Indoor Map
description: Renders third-party Mapxus indoor vector tiles/styles/sprites over a Mapbox streets style, with a venue picker, floor control, indoor place search, and Mapxus's own indoor directions.

title: JWL Nowcast
description: A layer switcher over Mapbox's Japan Weather Layers tilesets (nowcast precipitation, rain/snow forecasts, wind particles, flood/landslide/alert risk meters) with a time-band slider and playback.

title: Language Selector — Map Labels
description: A dropdown that rewrites the Streets v12 style's label text-fields to switch place/POI names among 13 languages, falling back to English where untranslated.

title: 3PL Handoff Demo · Mapbox
description: A 3-step delivery checkout: Mapbox Address Autofill captures the address, a draggable-pin map confirms drop-off/access points, then a driver handoff card is built via the Static Images API.

title: 抽選 (Lottery)
description: A rotating 3D globe (dark style, Japanese labels) that spins through a lottery animation and calls an external AWS Lambda endpoint for a prize tier, with confetti/emoji celebration effects.

title: マップマッチングデモ (Map Matching Demo)
description: Lets the user click points on a Tokyo map (or upload a GeoJSON file) and sends them to the Map Matching API to snap them to roads under a chosen travel profile.

title: Mapbox AMAP
description: Overlays AutoNavi (AMap) raster tiles for Beijing on a Mapbox light-style base map, inserted just beneath the first symbol layer.

title: Merchants Tileset Overlay Demo
description: A Tokyo merchant-locator map with a filter panel (category/brand checkboxes, coupon/campaign toggles, name search) that filters a custom style's merchant point layer.

title: MPL 3D
description: A Threebox 3D demo where clicking sets start/end points, requests a walking route, animates a 3D character along it, and queries a tileset via the Tilequery API to scatter 3D models near the path.

title: Naurt Data Visualization
description: Compares Naurt-derived door/address point tilesets against Mapbox geocoding across Japan/NZ/US regions, with match-rate stats and click popups that reverse-geocode via the Geocoding v6 API.

title: Navigation Trace Visualization
description: Loads sample or uploaded CSV navigation traces (raw vs. device-matched GPS points) and can re-run a selected area through the Map Matching API to patch the reconstructed route.

title: NEA
description: A raster-array tileset viewer for Singapore NEA weather data (rainfall, radar, satellite, lightning, hotspots) with projection switching, color-scale controls, and a time-band slider.

title: NOTAM Proximity Demo
description: A synthetic-data demo plotting fictional flight routes and NOTAM zones near Singapore, using Turf to flag routes clear/alert/crossing against an adjustable threshold.

title: Osaka Indoor
description: Toggles between a 3D map and a floor-by-floor indoor map (mapbox.indoor-v1) with floor switching, room hover/selection, and a location search control.

title: POI Map Builder - Mapbox GL JS
description: Lets users click or enter coordinates to build a custom POI map, style markers, edit a legend/title, save/load JSON configs, and export the map as an image.

title: Precipitation Search
description: Plays back Japan precipitation nowcast/forecast raster tiles on a timeline; search results get a driving route, ETA, and current vs. arrival-time precipitation.

title: Random
description: Plots a color-coded vector tileset of points across Japan, filterable by type, and generates a driving isochrone to list only points inside it.

title: Return to Route Demo
description: Generates a driving route, simulates a route deviation, then ranks return-to-route options using the Matrix API.

title: Rivers
description: Shows a vector tileset of Japanese rivers as colored lines and auto-labels each visible river segment with its river code.

title: Sapporo Medical Facilities & Airport - Mapbox GL JS
description: A 3-tab POI showcase around Sapporo with numbered/icon markers, popups, a synced inset minimap, and a screenshot/export button.

title: Singapore Disaster Response
description: Mock Singapore disaster dashboard with hazard zones and shelters; clicking one draws precomputed (hardcoded, not live-routed) walking routes to the other.

title: Static Tiles Demo
description: Toggles a base map between Mapbox Satellite raster tiles and a custom style rendered via the raster tile endpoint, with a switcher for 8 map projections.

title: Store Location Comparison - Mapbox vs Google
description: Side-by-side Google Maps and Mapbox GL JS panes with synced camera movement; picking a store centers both maps and plots its brand icon.

title: Store Locator
description: A Google-Maps-style store locator with brand/amenity filters, geolocation, address search, and driving/walking directions to a store.

title: Storytelling
description: Scrollytelling map that flies through chapters of Mapbox's company history using Scrollama-driven scroll steps, with a synced bounds-overlay inset map.

title: Streets Extruded
description: 3D extruded-buildings view of downtown Singapore/Marina Bay with live sliders to change the building layer's fill-extrusion color and opacity.

title: Tap Payment
description: Japanese e-money transaction history UI that fetches nearby shop POIs from a third-party sightseeing API and draws a walking route via the Directions API.

title: Travel Highlights 2024
description: Editable round-the-world trip map with animated plane/train/car/ship icons flying leg to leg, Search Box city autocomplete, route editing, and canvas video recording.

title: Turn-by-Turn Navigation Demo
description: Turn-by-turn navigation demo that fetches routes from the Directions API and renders a GPS puck smoothed/snapped to roads via the Map Matching API.

title: Weather 3D
description: Japan precipitation nowcast/forecast viewer with a time slider over raster-array tiles, using the Tilequery API for local rain intensity and reverse geocoding for place names.

title: Wind Speed and Particles Demo
description: Wind-speed heatmap and animated particle layer over Australia from a raster-array-particle tileset, with controls for opacity, color scale, and particle behavior.

title: Directions Comparison - OSM vs Zenrin
description: Side-by-side dual-map comparison of Mapbox Directions API routes on OSM vs. Zenrin road data, with issue-report presets and per-map avoid-road toggles.

title: Real Estate (JP)
description: Real estate listing/search map for Japan.

title: Real Estate (EN)
description: English-language version of the Japan real estate listing/search map.

title: Tokyo Movement
description: Movement/mobility data visualization for Tokyo.

title: Optimization
description: Route optimization demo for Japan.

title: Tokyo Weather
description: Weather visualization for Tokyo.

title: Tokyo News
description: News-location visualization for Tokyo.

title: Navigate Trace
description: Navigation trace visualization hosted demo for Tokyo.

title: Calculate Area
description: Tool for calculating area over drawn map regions in Japan.

title: Search Japan
description: Address/place search demo for Japan.

title: Auto Search
description: Automated search demo.

title: Fleet
description: Fleet tracking/visualization CodePen demo.

title: Nowcast
description: Weather nowcast visualization CodePen demo.

title: Global Weather
description: Global weather visualization CodePen demo.

title: Typhoon
description: Typhoon tracking visualization CodePen demo.

title: Tokushima Movement
description: Movement data visualization for Tokushima.

title: Nearest vs Bilinear
description: Comparison of nearest-neighbor vs. bilinear raster resampling.

title: Raster vs Vector
description: Comparison of raster vs. vector tile rendering.

title: 3D Route
description: 3D route animation CodePen demo.

title: Static Images Boundaries
description: Static map image demo showing boundary overlays.

title: Exclude from Directions
description: Demonstrates excluding road types/areas from Directions API routes.
